policy.informationalOwnerIntent: Keep only genuinely useful informational, preparation, diagnostic, data-safety and evidence/case-study content as independent blog owners.
policy.commercialIntentPolicy: Blogs whose primary intent isร้านรับซื้อ, รับซื้อราคาเท่าไหร่, เช็คราคา or direct selling should not compete with money, brand, model or condition owners.
policy.winnerProtection: A clicked or page-one blog is not retired blindly. If its intent is still informational it remains KEEP_INFORMATIONAL; if commercial overlap is material it is staged for MERGE_TO_OWNER and requires one-hop migration QA before any HTTP redirect.
policy.releaseRule: R9 is staging-only. MERGE_TO_OWNER means noindex plus canonical-to-owner staging signal; RETIRE_CANDIDATE means noindex only. No HTTP 301 or 410 is released in R9.
policy.indexBudgetRule: Unclassified blog posts default to HOLD_NOINDEX and are excluded from sitemap and blog index until reviewed.
